verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents dedicated endpoints: private, provisioned instances reserved exclusively for your organization, running on capacity not shared with other customers. You can deploy custom fine-tuned models to them via a management API and monitor them with Prometheus metrics. This delivers the isolation-from-shared-pool core of the story, but nothing documents autoscaling of dedicated capacity, and the capacity runs on Cerebras hardware rather than GPUs. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling for dedicated endpoints, self-serve provisioning details, independent or hands-on corroboration of dedicated deployments.
